image_alt: A blue-fawn whippet in a green tartan collar stands on a railway platform next to a yellow train.

text.facebook: Since 13 November, all poultry in England must be kept indoors as bird flu cases rise. Government guidance says dogs can catch it too, though the risk is small, and ducks, geese, swans and gulls carry more risk than garden birds. My tip: put the lead on before you reach the pond or riverbank, not after your dog finds something. Don't touch dead wild birds, report them to Defra. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/bird-flu-and-dogs
